Scomber japonicus · throw flasher

Chub Mackerel Flasher

A 3D-printed, chrome-finished throw flasher for spearfishing. It comes in four bodies: a head-down "wounded bait" that spirals and flutters as it sinks, an S-curve, a U-shaped dead-bait curl, and a straight flutter body.
